paragraphs.text: Solaflora is a human and a guest of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .
Solaflora is an influencer. She enjoys flaunting her audience and her elaborate outfits for all to see. Wherever she goes, paparazzi follow.
The Astrotorium is one of Solaflora's favorite places to visit. Myra understands how much publicity she gets when Solaflora comes by, so Myra treats her like a star.
